title: Grade 3 French — Fri, Jun 05
description: Les couleurs — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis (vocabulary, agreement, sentences)
subject: french

questions.question: What is the feminine form of 'blanc'?
questions.explanation: 'Blanc' (m.) → 'blanche' (f.). This is an irregular feminine form.

questions.question: Complete: 'une voiture ___' (a red car).
questions.explanation: 'Rouge' ends in -e, so it stays the same: 'une voiture rouge'.

questions.question: Which colour is invariable (never changes)?
questions.explanation: 'Orange' (and 'marron') are invariable — they come from objects and never change form.

questions.question: How do you ask 'What colour is the flower?'
options: De quelle couleur est la fleur?
questions.explanation: 'De quelle couleur est la fleur?' = What colour is the flower?

questions.question: Complete: 'Mes chaussures sont ___' (My shoes are black — feminine plural).
What does 'J'aime les fleurs roses' mean?
questions.explanation: 'J'aime les fleurs roses.' = I like pink flowers.

questions.question: Answer 'De quelle couleur est le soleil?'
questions.explanation: 'Le soleil est jaune.' = The sun is yellow.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence: 'a white house'
What is 'un arc-en-ciel'?
questions.explanation: 'Un arc-en-ciel' = a rainbow. It is multicolore (multicoloured).

questions.question: Complete: 'Le ciel est bleu et les nuages sont ___' (white).
questions.explanation: 'Les nuages sont blancs.' = The clouds are white. (Nuages = masculine plural → blancs.)

questions.question: What colour is 'le chocolat'?
questions.explanation: 'Le chocolat est marron.' = Chocolate is brown.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly describes 'a green car and a black bike'?
options: Une voiture verte et un vélo noir
Une voiture vert et un vélo noire
Un voiture verte et une vélo noir
Une voiture verte et un vélo noire
questions.explanation: 'Une voiture verte' (f.) + 'un vélo noir' (m.). Each colour agrees with its own noun.

questions.question: Maya paints: 'le ciel bleu, le soleil jaune, l'herbe verte'. What did she paint?
options: Blue sky, yellow sun, green grass
Blue sky, red sun, green grass
Green sky, yellow sun, blue grass
Blue sea, yellow sun, green tree
questions.explanation: 'Le ciel bleu' = blue sky, 'le soleil jaune' = yellow sun, 'l'herbe verte' = green grass.
